summary_en: FY8/26 annual dividend raised to Y40/share (Y20 ordinary + Y10 commemorative + Y10 special) from prior Y30 forecast. Special dividend component of Y10/share added for H2 (period-end, effective Y26.11.20). Total payout Y282M. Prior year Y20/share (Y10 ordinary + Y10 commemorative).
title_en: Notice of Revision to Special Dividend and Period-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief: MERF Inc. announced on 17 August 2026 that its board has resolved to raise the FY8/26 (year ending 31 August 2026) annual dividend forecast from Y30/share to Y40/share. The revised payout consists of Y20/share ordinary dividend, Y10/share commemorative dividend, and Y10/share special dividend. The special dividend component (Y10/share) is newly added at the period-end and will be submitted for approval at the 41st Annual General Meeting scheduled for 19 November 2026. The distribution is effective 20 November 2026, with total dividend outlay of Y282 million. Management cited strong operational performance in the current period as the rationale for introducing the special dividend component, reaffirming its commitment to stable and continuous shareholder returns going forward.
